# Security Policy

Yap is research-grade software in early (`0.x-alpha`) development. Only the latest published alpha and the current `main` are supported; there are no backports to older versions.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for security problems.

Report privately through GitHub's **[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/tiansivive/yap/security/advisories/new)** button (repository **Security** tab → **Report a vulnerability**). This opens a private advisory visible only to the maintainer.

Response is best-effort — this is a personal project — but every report will be reviewed, and responsible disclosure is appreciated.
